name: [Photo] Ambrotype
nl: Ambrotype rendering: a collodion positive on black glass, silvery cream highlights against deep tonal blacks, short tonal scale, pouring swirls at the plate edge and varnish bloom, photograph style image.

name: [Photo] Salted Paper Print
nl: Salted-paper rendering: matte fibrous print with the sheet's own fibre visible, soft violet-brown tone, low contrast and gentle highlight roll-off, a faint even fog across the image, photograph style image.

name: [Photo] Dye Transfer Print
nl: Dye-transfer rendering: three dye layers laid in exact register, dense saturated colour with clean neutral greys, mid-century advertising punch, smooth glossy surface, photograph style image.

name: [Photo] Cibachrome Gloss
nl: Cibachrome rendering: azo dyes on a polyester base, glassy high-gloss surface, near-black shadows against vivid clean primaries, biting micro-contrast right across the frame, photograph style image.
negative: matte fibre paper, soft pastel tonality

name: [Photo] Slit-Scan Strip
nl: Slit-scan rendering: one narrow slit exposed continuously through time, forms smeared into long ribbons along the scan axis, motionless edges left needle-sharp, vertical banding throughout, photograph style image.

name: [Photo] Chronophotography
nl: Chronophotographic rendering: successive instants recorded on one plate, overlapping phases fanned across a black field, even stroboscopic spacing, bright rims where phases cross, photograph style image.
negative: single clean exposure, colour film palette

name: [Photo] Photogram
nl: Photogram rendering: objects laid straight onto the paper and exposed, luminous white silhouettes on dense black, soft penumbra where contact loosens, no lens-drawn detail anywhere, photograph style image.

name: [Photo] Solargraph
nl: Solargraph rendering: a months-long pinhole exposure printing stacked arcs of sun tracks, reversed muted colour, immobile forms softened to ghosts, heavy vignette and paper staining, photograph style image.

name: [Photo] Lumen Print
nl: Lumen rendering: sunlight printing directly onto silver paper over hours, pink, violet and sepia staining, soft contact edges, mottled uneven bleaching across the sheet, photograph style image.

name: [Photo] Swing-Lens Panorama
nl: Swing-lens rendering: a rotating slit sweeping a very wide field, horizon bowing gently through the frame, faint exposure banding between sweeps, tapered stretch towards both ends, photograph style image.

name: [Photo] Zoom-Burst
nl: Zoom-burst rendering: focal length pulled during a long exposure, radial streaks flung outward from a still centre, one small core left readable, colour smeared into rays, photograph style image.

name: [Photo] Star-Trail Stack
nl: Star-trail rendering: hundreds of night frames stacked into concentric arcs about the pole, warm light pollution banding the horizon, faint gaps where frames join, deep blue-black sky, photograph style image.

name: [Photo] Microfiche Scan
nl: Microfiche rendering: a high-contrast library scan, blown-out white ground with crushed grey midtones, dust specks and scratch lines, soft optical fall-off into the corners, photograph style image.

name: [Photo] Copy-Stand Reproduction
nl: Copy-stand rendering: flat frontal documentation, cross-polarised light with every specular killed, colour-target neutrality, dead-square framing and no depth cue at all, photograph style image.

name: [Photo] Strip Camera Finish
nl: Strip-camera rendering: a fixed slit recording against continuously moving film, forms stretched or squeezed by their own speed, repeating banded background, no perspective convergence, photograph style image.

name: [Photo] Cloud Chamber Track
nl: Cloud-chamber rendering: condensation trails threading a vapour volume, thin bright forked tracks curling through a field, dark chamber ground, shallow depth softening the far trails, photograph style image.
negative: solid opaque forms, flat graphic shapes

name: [Photo] High-Speed Strobe
nl: High-speed strobe rendering: a microsecond flash freezing a splash crown mid-collapse, needle-sharp droplet rims, black velvet ground, hard specular points along every wet edge, photograph style image.
negative: long exposure smear, ambient soft light

name: [Photo] Trail Camera Infrared
nl: Trail-camera rendering: monochrome infrared flash at night, flat frontal light falling off hard into blackness, bright eye-shine, a burnt-in data bar and heavy sensor noise, photograph style image.

name: [Photo] Endoscope Fisheye
nl: Endoscope rendering: a tiny wide-angle lens held close to a wet surface, strong barrel distortion, circular black vignette framing the field, hot ring-light hotspot glaring off moisture, photograph style image.
negative: long lens compression, dry matte surfaces

name: [Photo] Cinewhoop Drone
nl: Cinewhoop rendering: an ultra-wide micro-drone lens, horizon warped and rolling hard, propeller tips smearing the frame corners, punchy contrast and deep saturation, photograph style image.

name: [Cinema] Two-Strip Technicolor
nl: Two-strip rendering: only red-orange and blue-green records present, yellows absent and cyans gone muddy, skin running warm brick, soft registration fringing at every edge, film still style image.
negative: full modern colour gamut, clean digital grade

name: [Cinema] Kinescope Broadcast
nl: Kinescope rendering: film shot off a television tube, scanline mush and blooming whites, crushed greys, a jittering frame edge and heavy grain over everything, film still style image.

name: [Cinema] Rear-Projection Process
nl: Process-shot rendering: a flat projected plate behind the foreground, grain and contrast mismatched between the two layers, gentle plate flicker, hard studio key on the front, film still style image.

name: [Cinema] Day-for-Night
nl: Day-for-night rendering: daylight underexposed and printed cold, blue-shifted midtones under a still-bright sky, shadows keeping their daytime direction, filtered dense blacks, film still style image.
negative: true night lighting, warm practical lamps

name: [Cinema] Hand-Cranked Silent
nl: Hand-cranked rendering: an uneven frame rate quickening and dragging, orthochromatic tonality with dark skies and pale skin, iris vignette closing the corners, dust, splices and frame jump, film still style image.
